title: State-dependent decoupling of sensory and motor circuits underlies behavioral flexibility in Drosophila.
source_locator: Results, 'Two identified DN types contribute to landing responses'; Fig. 1e; Supplementary Fig. 3; Supplementary videos 4-5
quote: Only two DN types, DNp07 and DNp10 (Fig. 1d), drove landing-like extensions of all six legs when activated
mapping_basis: Paper uses the Namiki type name DNp07, which is a MANC type name in type_list.csv; SS01549 maps to DNp07 (with DNp13) in driver_lines.csv.
stimulation: 625 nm fiber-coupled LED aimed at the fly from below; 300-ms pulses in Fig. 1 experiments; intensities per Supplementary Fig. 7e
sensory_condition: tethered flight (pin on dorsal thorax, legs free), filmed from below at 125 fps
coordination_notes: simultaneous extension of all six legs, front legs reaching beyond the head (landing posture)
n_flies_note: Fig. 1e: leg extension angle n = 12 front legs from N = 6 flies; latency n = 21 trials from N = 7 flies
notes: DNp07-split-GAL4-2 (SS01549) was the line used for Fig. 1e and Supp. Fig. 3 (Methods). Supp. Fig. 1b: SS01549 expresses strongly in DNp07 with weaker expression in DNp13 (DNp13 does not innervate leg neuropils). Landing leg extension is a single movement, so leg rhythm = no. The fly was flying, not walking. The 133-line flight screen named only DNp07 and DNp10 as positives; the other lines are not listed in the paper or supplement, so no records for them.

title: State-dependent decoupling of sensory and motor circuits underlies behavioral flexibility in Drosophila.
source_locator: Fig. 1e; Supplementary Fig. 3 (activation with SS01549); Supplementary Fig. 1b (SS01549 expression in DNp13)
quote: Optogenetic activation of DNp07 or DNp10 drove landing responses in flying flies.
mapping_basis: Paper names the off-target DN in SS01549 as DNp13 (Supp. Fig. 1b), a MANC type name; driver_lines.csv lists SS01549 for DNp13 with DNp07.
stimulation: 625 nm fiber-coupled LED aimed at the fly from below; 300-ms pulses in Fig. 1 experiments
coordination_notes: simultaneous extension of all six legs (landing posture)
n_flies_note: same experiment as the DNp07/SS01549 record
notes: Record exists only because SS01549 also labels DNp13 (weak expression, Supp. Fig. 1b: 'which expressed strongly in DNp07, and had weaker expression in a second DN (DNp13)'). The authors attribute the phenotype to DNp07 and say DNp13 does not innervate leg neuropils. They also got the same phenotype with SS02276, which has no DNp13. The quote is the paper's statement of the result for the line, not a claim about DNp13.
